extension.description: Runs only the .NET test methods your change can reach: on save, a Roslyn analyzer finds the impacted tests, and only their test projects are built and run.
untrustedWorkspaces.description: Aftershock builds and runs the workspace's code, which needs a trusted workspace.
virtualWorkspaces.description: Aftershock runs dotnet on the local file system.
config.solution: Solution (`.sln` or `.slnx`) to analyze, absolute or relative to the workspace folder. Empty: the first solution in the workspace root (by name), else the shallowest one below it.
config.debounceMs: Time to wait after a save before analyzing (milliseconds). Further saves in this time are analyzed together.
config.maxImpactedSymbols: Limit of the caller search per changed file (non-test symbols). Above it, the dependent test projects run completely. `0` means no limit.
config.fallbackGlobs: Files whose change runs the dependent test projects completely (relative to the repository or solution folder; a pattern without `/` matches the file name anywhere). Setting a value replaces the default.
config.testFilter: Extra VSTest filter for every run, for example `Category!=Integration`. Combined with the selection as `(<selection>)&(<filter>)`. For xUnit v3 on Microsoft.Testing.Platform, simple `Trait=Value` / `Trait!=Value` terms are translated.
config.disableAnalyzersInBuild: Turn off Roslyn analyzers in Aftershock's builds (`-p:RunAnalyzers=false`) for faster feedback. Your normal builds and CI are not affected.
config.dotnetPath: The `dotnet` executable used to run the analyzer, builds and tests.
